id: title:jose-sequeira:index stack frames by team and created at

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a database index on `ErrorTrackingStackFrame` to optimize query performance for team-specific and time-bounded scans, while using a concurrent migration helper to maintain availability.
review.reason: Adds a database index on team and created_at fields for ErrorTrackingStackFrame, supported by a migration file using SafeAddIndexConcurrently. This improves query performance for team-specific and time-bounded scans while maintaining availability during migration.
review.uncertainty: The actual performance improvement and compatibility with existing query patterns are not demonstrated by execution or test results, only by the implementation and comments.

observations.limitations: This chunk represents a database migration and model update. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F3.H1 describe the same index addition: P1.F3.H1 adds the index definition to the model, while P1.F1.H1 creates the migration file. P1.F2.H1 updates the migration marker. No conflicting or unrelated PRs are present. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a database index on team and created_at fields for ErrorTrackingStackFrame.
observations.posthog_connection: Reduces the cost of queries filtering ErrorTrackingStackFrame by team and created_at, such as recent-frames-per-team scans, by allowing the database to skip older frames. This supports the comment's claim that without this index, a 24h window would visit every frame ever stored.

observations.behavior: Creates a migration file to apply the index addition.
observations.posthog_connection: Uses SafeAddIndexConcurrently, a migration helper, to add the index. This suggests the index addition is performed concurrently to avoid blocking writes, which could help maintain availability during the migration.
